title: Descent data for a singleton fpqc cover remain fully faithful after a refinement
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. Let $f:X\to S$ and $g:X'\to S$ be morphisms such that both singleton families are fpqc coverings [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering], and let $h:X'\to X$ be a morphism over $S$ with $g=f\circ h$. Pulling a descent datum $(V,\varphi)$ on a scheme $V$ over $X/S$ [def-pd-descent-datum] back along $h$ gives a descent datum over $X'/S$. The resulting pullback functor from descent data over $X/S$ to descent data over $X'/S$ is fully faithful: for any two data, compatible morphisms between their pullbacks arise uniquely from a compatible morphism between the original data.
